title: Clícalo icon library
description: Icons offered by the icon picker (CAT-002, EDI-004, D14): every icon of the bundled Material Symbols Rounded font with its category and the English keywords of the official metadata; the curated ones also have hand-written search words per language. The order of «icons» is the order suggestIcons walks (EDI-005): the curated icons first, then the rest, most popular first.

$comment.description: Which parts are edited by hand and which ones tools/fonts/build_fonts.py writes. Ignored by the product.

defaults.description: Icon of a new shortcut and of a new profile without suggestion (EDI-005).

featured.description: Icons shown first in the shortcut icon picker when there is no search (EDI-004).

profileFeatured.description: Base icons of the profile icon grid (ATJ-004, PLA-010).

categories.description: Categories of the Material Symbols metadata, in the order of the picker (D14).

tags.description: Hand-written search words of a curated icon (CAT-002). Icons without them are found by their name and their keywords.

keywords.description: English search words of the Material Symbols metadata, written by tools/fonts/build_fonts.py.

iconCategoryId.description: Category of an icon, listed in «categories».
